items.title: Kraft Heinz Q2 Earnings Beat as 2026 Organic Sales Outlook Improves
items.summary: Kraft Heinz beat Q2 earnings and sales estimates and raised its 2026 organic sales outlook, but weak North America volumes and margin pressure remain.

items.title: Is Kraft Heinz Stock a Buy as Low Valuation Meets Execution Risk?
items.summary: Kraft Heinz trades at a discount and generates strong cash flow, but weak volumes, inflation and softer earnings keep execution risk in focus.

items.title: Mondelēz brings UK protein bar Grenade to the US
items.summary: The Clif and Perfect Bar owner is doubling down on its domestic bar portfolio to leverage growing consumer demand for protein and portability.

items.title: Can Mondelez Build on 2.5% Growth in Biscuits and Baked Snacks?
items.summary: Mondelez's biscuits and baked snacks grow 2.5% in Q2 as volume/mix, brand gains and share trends strengthen, with innovation offering more growth levers.

items.title: Mondelez CEO Dirk Van De Put Sells 134,000 Shares for $8.5 Million
items.summary: Van De Put exercised stock options and immediately sold the shares under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan adopted in May. His remaining direct holdings exceed $85 million.

items.title: Can Hershey step up to buy Mondelez?
items.summary: Investing.com -- Hershey and Mondelez are more likely to expand partnerships in international markets than pursue a full-scale merger in the near term, Bernstein said, pointing to the success of their recent Reese’s and Oreo product collaborations.
